训练页参数很多，但绝大部分保持默认即可。第一次训练只需要确认下面这几项：: There are many parameters on the training page, but most of them can be kept as default. For the first training, you only need to confirm the following items:
没有数据什么都练不了: Nothing can be practiced without data
与底模训练分辨率一致效果最好: The best effect is consistent with the training resolution of the base model.
配合每 2 epoch 保存 + 预览图挑最佳轮次: Combined with saving every 2 epochs + previewing images to pick the best round
不然 output 目录里全是 aki.safetensors: Otherwise, the output directory is full of aki.safetensors
常规选 LoRA；画风可试 LoKr: Generally choose LoRA; for painting style you can try LoKr
不是越大越好，先小后大: It’s not that bigger is better, small first and then big
每 2 epoch 出一张图，肉眼看进度: A picture is produced every 2 epochs, and the progress can be seen with the naked eye.
总训练步数 = 图片数 × 重复次数 × epoch ÷ batch_size。: Total number of training steps = number of images × number of repetitions × epoch ÷ batch_size. Character LoRA generally starts with 1000~2000 steps, and the painting style requires more. Step count is not a goal;
预览图和测试出图才是唯一标准: Preview pictures and test pictures are the only standards
Anima 主 DiT / transformer 权重路径（如 anima-b: Anima main DiT/transformer weight path (e.g. anima-base-v1.0.safetensors). The "base model" for training, LoRA learns the increment relative to it, and there will be deviations in the drawings when changing the base model.
Qwen Image VAE 路径，Anima 训练必填。VAE 负责把图片压缩: Qwen Image VAE path, required for Anima training. VAE is responsible for compressing images into latent ("abbreviated language" about 1/8 size), and training is performed in latent space
Qwen3 文本模型路径（Anima 的文本编码器，替代 SD 系的 CLIP）: Qwen3 text model path (Anima's text encoder, replacing the SD system's CLIP). Can fill in safetensors / pt file or complete model directory
单独的 LLM Adapter 权重（可选）。填写后覆盖主模型内置 Adapte: Separate LLM Adapter weights (optional). After filling in, overwrite the built-in Adapter of the main model
T5 tokenizer 目录（可选，留空用内置 configs/t5_old）: T5 tokenizer directory (optional, leave blank to use built-in configs/t5_old)
保存的中断状态继续训练。与\"读取已有 LoRA 继续练\"（network_w: Continue training from the saved interrupted state. Different from "read existing LoRA and continue training" (network_weights): resume restores the complete training progress (including optimizer status and number of steps)
Anima 是 Rectified Flow（整流流）模型：训练目标是学习\"从: Anima is a Rectified Flow (rectified flow) model: the training goal is to learn "the straight path from noise to the picture", which is different from the DDPM denoising and denoising of the SD system, so it has a set of exclusive time step parameters.
训练时从哪些\"去噪进度点\"采样学习。: Which "denoising progress points" are sampled from during training.
为 Anima 官方推荐；uniform 均匀采样，sigmoid 偏中段: Officially recommended by Anima; uniform sampling, sigmoid partial to the middle
Rectified Flow 位移。值越大越偏向高噪声（大结构）阶段，保持默认即: Rectified Flow displacement. The larger the value, the more biased it is toward the high noise (large structure) stage. Just keep the default.
sigmoid 采样的缩放，仅 timestep_sampling=sigmoi: Sigmoid sampling scaling, only relevant when timestep_sampling=sigmoid
不同时间步的 loss 权重策略。uniform = 一视同仁；logit_no: Loss weighting strategies at different time steps. uniform = treat all people equally; logit_normal, etc. will focus on the middle time step (supported by logit_mean / logit_std / mode_scale fine-tuning)
文本最长 token 数。标签很长（JSON 结构化标签）时才需要考虑加大，越大: The longest number of tokens in the text. When the tag is very long (JSON structured tag), you need to consider increasing the size. The larger the tag, the higher the memory.

拆分 attention 计算换显存，牺牲速度: Split attention calculation into video memory, sacrificing speed
VAE 编解码分块（需偶数），大图爆显存时再设: VAE codec block (needs even number), set again when large image exceeds video memory
禁用内部 VAE 缓存，一般不动: Disables internal VAE cache, generally does not change
把激活值卸载到内存的省显存兜底，不能与 blocks_to_swap / cpu: The memory-saving method of offloading activation values to memory cannot be opened together with blocks_to_swap / cpu_offload_checkpointing.

正则化图像的 loss 权重，用了正则集才有意义: The loss weight of the regularized image is meaningful only if a regular set is used.

每 N 轮存一个中间模型，配合预览图挑\"火候正好\"的那一版。与: Save an intermediate model every N rounds, and choose the version that is "just right" based on the preview image. with

训练总轮数。一轮 = 完整过一遍数据集（含重复次数）: The total number of training rounds. One round = a complete pass through the data set (including the number of repetitions)
一次喂几张图。越大梯度越稳、可配更高学习率，但显存线性上涨。2 倍 batch: Feed several pictures at a time. The larger the gradient, the more stable it is and can be equipped with a higher learning rate, but the memory will increase linearly. 2 times batch ≈ approximately 2 times DiT learning rate available
\"以算换存\"：前向不留中间结果、反向时重算，大幅省显存、速度略降。DiT 训: "Calculate for save": No intermediate results are left in the forward direction, and recalculation occurs in the reverse direction, which greatly saves video memory and slightly reduces the speed. DiT training is basically a must
梯度累加：攒 N 个小 batch 再更新一次，等效大 batch 而不涨显存（: Gradient accumulation: save N small batches and update them again, which is equivalent to a large batch without increasing the video memory (speed in exchange for stability)
只训练 DiT 主体，不训练 Qwen3 文本编码器。: Only the DiT agent is trained, not the Qwen3 text encoder.

Qwen3 文本编码器学习率。默认只训 DiT（unet_only 开启），此项: Qwen3 text encoder learning rate. By default, only DiT is trained (unet_only is turned on). This item is usually
学习率曲线：cosine 系\"先高后低\"最常用；constant 全程恒定（: Learning rate curve: cosine is the most commonly used "high first and then low"; constant is constant throughout the process (adaptive optimizers such as Prodigy must be equipped with constant); those with warmup first climb and then descend. Number of restarts

损失函数。l2（MSE）为标准选择；huber / smooth_l1 对离群样: loss function. l2 (MSE) is the standard choice; huber / smooth_l1 is more robust to outlier samples

：补丁的\"表达力\"。想象用几根线去拟合一幅画：线越多（rank 越高）能描得: : The "expressiveness" of the patch. Imagine using several lines to fit a painting: the more lines (the higher the rank), the thinner the line can be drawn, but the easier it is to learn the noise of the training set together.
：补丁的\"音量旋钮\"。实际缩放 = alpha ÷ dim，所以 alpha: :Patch's "Volume Knob". Actual scaling = alpha ÷ dim, so alpha is always set to dim or dim/2.
：用两块小拼图\"相乘\"拼出一整面大墙。同样一面墙，存两块小拼图比存整面墙省得: : Use two small puzzle pieces to "multiply" to build a whole large wall. For the same wall, it takes much less time to store two small puzzle pieces than to store the entire wall - this is why the LoKr coefficients are small.
：把\"往哪个方向改\"和\"改多大力度\"拆开来学。DoRA 只按行（输出维）: : Separate "in which direction to change" and "how vigorously to change" to learn. DoRA only decouples by row (output dimension); BoRA decouples in both row and column directions, and then alternates and balances for several rounds to control the intensity more evenly.
：不在显存里重建大矩阵，直接作用于激活值。适合量化底模或显存紧张，但与 DoRA: : Does not reconstruct the large matrix in the video memory and acts directly on the activation value. Suitable for quantized base models or memory constraints, but mutually exclusive with DoRA/BoRA decoupling.
